name: Zalaszegvár (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, light grey and green in the ratio 2:1:2, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Zalaszegvár: a crowned green and blue shield with a yellow lion and a white castle.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
